title: TR-EIF Conservative Energy Output
description: Structural JSON schema for the scalar conservative energy output represented by tr_eif.energy.EnergyState.

atomic_energies.description: Ordered finite scalar atomic energy contributions, one contribution per represented atom.

$comment: Energy is a continuous scalar observable and is not a balanced-ternary state. No energy value, sign, zero value, missing value, validation status, or physical condition is mapped automatically to -1/0/1. The current conservative energy functional constructs total_energy from deterministic atomic contributions. Algebraic consistency between total_energy and atomic_energies, finite-value enforcement, and atom-count consistency with the associated configuration remain executable validation responsibilities rather than being approximated by structural JSON Schema constraints. This schema does not impose an implicit physical unit.
